vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: slogan-maker
Version: 1.0.5

The skill bundle provides a functional slogan generation tool with no evidence of malicious intent or data exfiltration. It contains two shell scripts: 'scripts/slogan.sh' implements the core logic for generating and testing slogans, while 'scripts/script.sh' is a generic data logging utility that manages local files in the user's data directory. No network activity, sensitive file access, or obfuscated code was detected.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (local slogan generation and simple heuristics); it contains bash scripts that run locally, create a small data directory and logs, and does not request credentials or perform network exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (slogan maker) match the provided code and instructions. The included scripts implement slogan generation, translation suggestions, industry templates, rhyme helpers, and a local testing heuristic — all coherent with the description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within scope (describes command usage). The scripts do perform local file writes (create DATA_DIR, data.log, history.log) which SKILL.md doesn't explicitly warn about. There are no instructions to read unrelated system files, access secrets, or send data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only skill). Two included shell scripts run locally; nothing is downloaded or extracted from remote URLs. This is the lowest-risk install posture given the provided files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials. The scripts honor an optional SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR env var to control storage location; by default they create ~/.local/share/slogan-maker and write logs/data there. That persistent storage is reasonable for a CLI tool but users should be aware of it.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true and does not modify other skills or system-wide configs. Its persistence is limited to creating and writing files in its own data directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: generate and evaluate slogans locally. Before installing or running: (1) review the two shell scripts if you are cautious— they will create a directory (default: ~/.local/share/slogan-maker) and write data.log and history.log there; (2) there are no network calls or credential requests in the code, but SKILL.md includes a feedback URL (informational only); (3) if you prefer no persistent files, set SLOGAN_MAKER_DIR to a temporary directory or run in an isolated environment; (4) avoid running unreviewed scripts as root. Overall the footprint is small and proportionate to the stated purpose.
